name: The Bouncer
description: Sweet-talk or slip past the muscle on the door.
failure_consequence: The door staff start remembering faces.
success_bonus: The crew walks in as guests.
critical_success_reward: He waves the whole crew through without a look.
critical_failure_effect: He calls it in, and the room gets watchful.

name: Cloakroom Cabinet
description: A cheap cabinet holding better things than it should.
failure_consequence: The lock jams, and the attendant returns early.

name: Back Alley Exit
description: Out through the service door and into the delivery lane.
failure_consequence: A kitchen hand watches the crew leave.

name: Counting Room
description: The night's take, still in the trays.
failure_consequence: The tray alarm trips and the floor manager is paged.
critical_success_reward: The float is untouched and unrecorded.

name: Camera Bank
description: Blind the watchful electronic eyes, briefly.
failure_consequence: Security notices a gap in the feed and starts a sweep.
critical_success_reward: The whole floor's coverage loops for the run.

name: Night Patrol
description: Two guards, one route, and eleven predictable minutes.
failure_consequence: A guard turns early and the crew has to move loudly.
critical_failure_effect: The patrol calls in an unscheduled check.

name: Main Vault Door
description: Open the steel with finesse, before the time lock notices.
failure_consequence: The time-lock alarm trips and the response clock starts.
critical_success_reward: The door opens clean, and quietly, and early.

name: Laser Grid
description: Dance through the web of beams across the gallery floor.
failure_consequence: A beam breaks, and a silent alarm starts a clock.
critical_failure_effect: The gallery shutters begin to close.

name: The Night Curator
description: Convince a cultured insomniac that you belong here.
failure_consequence: He is polite, and then he calls the desk.

name: Pressure-Sensitive Case
description: Lift the piece without letting the plate know it left.
failure_consequence: The case alarm carries through the whole wing.
critical_success_reward: The swap is perfect; nobody looks for days.

name: Executive Elevator
description: Talk the lift controller into the floors it protects.
failure_consequence: The car locks out and the stairwell is the only way up.

name: Penthouse Safe
description: A private safe, bought for looks and installed for it too.
failure_consequence: The secondary system arms and cannot be disarmed twice.
critical_success_reward: There is more in it than the file said.

name: Board Room Crossing
description: Cross a glass room that was designed to be looked into.
failure_consequence: A late executive sees movement and is not sure enough to shout.

name: Loading Dock
description: Over the roller door before the shift bell.
failure_consequence: A dropped crate brings the dock foreman out.

name: Server Cage
description: A locked rack, a hot aisle, and a very short window.
failure_consequence: The intrusion is logged, and logs are read on Mondays.
critical_success_reward: The logs are rewritten as a maintenance window.

name: Reception Desk
description: Sign in as somebody the building expects.
failure_consequence: The visitor log now has a face and a bad name on it.

name: Roof Approach
description: Four storeys of service ladder and one bad parapet.
failure_consequence: A fall, a noise, and a very long minute of standing still.

name: The Dog Run
description: Two shepherds who take their work more seriously than the guards.
failure_consequence: Barking, and lights coming on in the yard office.

name: Armed Response
description: Two contractors, alerted, and between the crew and the street.
failure_consequence: Somebody gets hurt, and somebody makes a statement.
critical_failure_effect: The response calls for backup on an open channel.

name: Skylight Drop
description: Eleven metres of controlled descent onto a marble floor.
failure_consequence: A hard landing, a loud one, and a turned ankle.
critical_success_reward: The line is set for the way out as well.

name: The Auction Floor
description: Bid, be seen, and be the reason nobody watches the back.
failure_consequence: A dealer recognises the face and mentions it to the house.
critical_success_reward: The house treats the crew as a client for the night.

name: Biometric Door
description: Two factors, one of which is a person who went home at six.
failure_consequence: A failed read locks the door for an hour and files a ticket.
critical_failure_effect: The floor goes into lockdown.

name: The Deposit Boxes
description: Four hundred small locks, and only nine that matter.
failure_consequence: A drilled box is obvious by morning and traceable by noon.
critical_success_reward: Nine boxes open, and a tenth that looked interesting.

name: The Harbour Fence
description: A lit yard, a patrolled line, and water on three sides.
failure_consequence: A spotlight finds the line, and the yard wakes up.

name: Sweep Team
description: The alarm brought people, and the people brought torches.
failure_consequence: The sweep finds the crew's route and follows it.

name: Responding Unit
description: Somebody called it in, and somebody came.
failure_consequence: An arrest is attempted, and it goes badly for everyone.

name: Lockdown Shutter
description: The building decided to close around the crew.
failure_consequence: The shutter stays down and the way out gets longer.

name: Panicked Witness
description: A cleaner who was not supposed to be on this floor.
failure_consequence: They run, and they talk, and they are believed.

name: The Coat Check
description: A girl with a ledger and four hundred pockets behind her.
failure_consequence: She keeps the ticket stub and the description that goes with it.
critical_success_reward: She hands over somebody else's key along with the coat.

name: Service Stair
description: Concrete, echo, and a door at every landing.
failure_consequence: Footsteps carry up four floors and somebody counts them.
critical_success_reward: The stairwell turns out to run all the way to the roof.
critical_failure_effect: A fire door slams four floors down and the sound climbs.

name: The Delivery Book
description: Sign for something nobody ordered and walk it inside.
failure_consequence: The clerk phones the depot to check, and the depot answers.
critical_success_reward: The crew is given a trolley and directions to the vault corridor.

name: The Sash Window
description: Painted shut in 1931 and never opened since.
failure_consequence: The frame splinters and the noise carries into the street.

name: The Yard Wall
description: Three metres of brick with glass set into the top of it.
failure_consequence: A shredded palm and a stain on the coping that will be found.

name: The Night Porter
description: Forty years on this desk and an opinion about everybody.
failure_consequence: He remembers a face and matches it to a name by morning.
critical_failure_effect: He rings the residents' bell and half the building wakes.

name: The Meter Cupboard
description: Everything the building runs on, behind a lock worth six pounds.
failure_consequence: The door hangs open and announces that somebody was interested.
critical_success_reward: The whole floor's lighting circuit is theirs to turn off.

name: Through the Kitchen
description: Steam, shouting, and nobody with time to look up.
failure_consequence: A chef takes exception and remembers taking it.
critical_success_reward: A chef assumes they are the new supplier and holds the door.
critical_failure_effect: A pan goes over and the whole service stops to look.

name: The Guest Register
description: A name in a book, written badly enough to be anyone's.
failure_consequence: The signature does not match the one already on the page.
critical_success_reward: The name they signed turns out to have an account here.
critical_failure_effect: The signature is compared to one on the page above it.

name: The Alarm Panel
description: Eight zones, one keypad, and ninety seconds of entry delay.
failure_consequence: Zone four reports open and the monitoring station calls back.
critical_success_reward: Every zone reads secure for the rest of the night.
critical_failure_effect: The panel dials out before anybody can stop it.

name: The Dumbwaiter
description: A shaft built for soup, being asked to carry a person.
failure_consequence: The cable slips and the car drops a floor with somebody in it.
critical_success_reward: The shaft runs to a floor that is not on the plan.
critical_failure_effect: The car jams with somebody in it, between floors.

name: The Strongroom Grille
description: Bars set in stone, and a gate lock older than the bank.
failure_consequence: The wards jam and the gate is now a wall.

name: The Cellar Route
description: A coal chute, a flooded corridor, and the building's own foundations.
failure_consequence: A slip in the dark, and everything gets wet including the tools.
critical_success_reward: The old service tunnel comes out inside the vault corridor.
critical_failure_effect: The chute collapses behind them and takes the way back.

name: The Records Room
description: Nine hundred boxes and one that matters.
failure_consequence: The index is wrong and the search costs twenty minutes nobody has.
critical_success_reward: The file is found, copied, and put back the right way round.

name: The Watchman's Round
description: A key clock on every floor, punched to the minute.
failure_consequence: He punches early, which is the same as noticing.
critical_success_reward: His route is learned well enough to use on the way out.

name: The Private Office
description: The door with no nameplate, on the floor with no visitors.
failure_consequence: The lock is changed by morning and the file inside is moved.

name: The Manifest
description: Talk a clerk into the crate number that matters.
failure_consequence: He fetches the supervisor to be helpful, which he is not.

name: The Sluice Gate
description: Cold water, a rusted wheel, and eleven minutes of tide.
failure_consequence: The gate sticks half open and the channel floods behind them.
critical_failure_effect: Somebody goes into the water and the yard hears the splash.

name: The Switchboard
description: Every line in the building, and a woman who knows all of them.
failure_consequence: A call gets through that should not have.
critical_success_reward: The building's outside lines are theirs to cut for an hour.

name: The Gallery Balcony
description: A rail, a drop, and the piece hanging just out of reach.
failure_consequence: A hand slips and the whole gallery hears the rail take the weight.

name: The Trophy Case
description: Glass, brass, and a hinge that has never been opened quietly.
failure_consequence: The hinge shrieks and the room stops pretending it did not hear.
critical_success_reward: The case closes behind them exactly as it was.

name: The Chauffeur
description: He is paid to wait, and he is very good at waiting.
failure_consequence: He walks the car round the block and finds a reason to mention it.
critical_failure_effect: He drives straight to the house and tells them who was asking.

name: The Guard Room
description: Four of them, a kettle, and a monitor wall.
failure_consequence: Four is more than anybody planned for, and they all stand up.
critical_success_reward: The monitor wall is theirs and nobody is awake to mind.
critical_failure_effect: One reaches the wall panel before anyone reaches him.

name: The Cold Store
description: Minus twenty, a sealed door, and eight minutes of usable hands.
failure_consequence: Fingers stop working before the job is finished.

name: The Ledger Safe
description: Not money. Names, and what they paid.
failure_consequence: The relocker arms and the safe becomes furniture.
critical_success_reward: The ledger is photographed and returned to its shelf.

name: The Rooftop Run
description: Six buildings, four gaps, and one skylight that is not boarded.
failure_consequence: A gap is misjudged and the rest of the run is done limping.
critical_success_reward: The whole rooftop line becomes the way out as well.

name: The Time Lock
description: A clock that only opens the door when it feels like it.
failure_consequence: The clock is nudged, notices, and adds an hour out of spite.
critical_success_reward: The clock is persuaded that it is already Monday.

name: The Wine Cellar
description: Two thousand bottles, one of which is a door handle.
failure_consequence: A rack goes over, and two thousand bottles disagree loudly.
critical_success_reward: The hidden door is found in half the expected time.

name: The Private Wing
description: Where the family sleeps, and nobody is paid to be quiet.
failure_consequence: A light comes on in a bedroom and stays on.
critical_failure_effect: Somebody screams, which is the worst possible alarm.

name: The Counting Floor
description: Twenty clerks, forty eyes, and the night's take on the table.
failure_consequence: One clerk stops counting and looks up, and then they all do.
critical_success_reward: A supervisor hands them a tray to carry and looks away.
critical_failure_effect: Twenty clerks stop counting at once, which is its own alarm.

name: The Server Vault
description: Cold, loud, and the only room in the building that is really locked.
failure_consequence: The rack logs a physical intrusion, which is a different kind of trouble.
critical_success_reward: The whole array is mirrored and nobody is any the wiser.

name: The Wall Safe
description: Behind the portrait, exactly where the film said it would be.
failure_consequence: The dial spins free and the mechanism behind it does not.
critical_success_reward: It opens on the first combination they try, which is unnerving.

name: The Bodyguards
description: Two men whose entire job is the next thirty seconds.
failure_consequence: They are better at this than the crew, and it shows immediately.
critical_failure_effect: One of them draws, and after that it is a different night.

name: The Atrium
description: Nine floors of open air with a marble floor at the bottom.
failure_consequence: The line swings wide and puts somebody against the glass.
critical_success_reward: They cross unseen and leave the line rigged for the return.

name: The Lot Itself
description: Under glass, under guard, and under a hundred pairs of eyes.
failure_consequence: The case is opened badly and the room notices before the guard does.
critical_success_reward: The swap is so good the house sells the copy that evening.

name: The Keyholder
description: One person in the city can open this, and they are at dinner.
failure_consequence: They excuse themselves, and they do not come back alone.
critical_success_reward: They open it themselves, apologising for the delay.

name: The Pressure Floor
description: Every tile weighed, every weight logged, and one route across.
failure_consequence: A tile registers four kilos too many and the room seals.
critical_failure_effect: The floor locks down with the crew standing on it.

name: The Black Room
description: No windows, no lights, no plan of it anywhere in the city.
failure_consequence: They come out of it having learned only that it is bigger than expected.
critical_success_reward: They map it in one pass and know it better than the owner.

name: The Arbiter
description: The system that decides who the building believes.
failure_consequence: It stops believing anybody, including the people who work there.
critical_success_reward: It believes the crew works here, and keeps believing it.
critical_failure_effect: It writes them into a report that goes out at midnight.

name: The Fire Marshal
description: An alarm brought a man with a clipboard and a headcount.
failure_consequence: The headcount comes out one too many, twice.

name: The Dog Handler
description: The dog found something. The handler is coming to see what.
failure_consequence: The dog is right, and everybody now knows the dog is right.

name: The Jammed Exit
description: The way out picked tonight to stop being a way out.
failure_consequence: The door holds, and the corridor behind them does not stay empty.

name: The Second Safe
description: There was another one. Nobody's file mentioned another one.
failure_consequence: Time spent on a safe that turns out to hold stationery.
